When a test environment became temporarily unavailable, the team restored it quickly but did not stop every production activity or start a large investigation. Treating every event as equally serious can waste time and make important incidents harder to notice. A proportionate response considers the scope, duration, risk, and customer impact before deciding how much attention and effort are appropriate.
